I got a knock on my door around 8 at night. It was roommate, an older man who works from home pretty often. I told him to come in and he had this look of bewilderment on his face. I asked him what was up. He stood there in my doorway and exclaimed that and I quote "Dude, There some Y2K shit going down or something..." I was completely confused and asked him what he was talking about. With an absolutely straight face, he asked me what time it was and I looked down at my computer and replied with "7:59". His response to my answer was "Yeah........ and what day is it.....?" I told him it was June 30th and he quickly with replied with "No! It's July 1st..., something is going on, they are even playing night time shows on the tv......"

After a couple of seconds I put two and two together and informed him that he only took a nap and didn't actually sleep all the way through the night. He sat down at the edge of my bed and contemplated in silence what I just said.

This is when my belly laugh started and it didn't stop for the next 5 minutes. My roommate had taken a nap and thought he slept through the night. I could see how one could sort of get confused with the lighting outside and nothing having an a.m. or a p.m. on it.

I went downstairs for a couple of minutes and then popped my head into my roommates room. He told me he was confused and thought something might have been up with the leap year second they were doing. After about a minute of small talk, I looked at him and asked if he was drinking coffee, I quickly followed that up with the question of was he eating breakfast. Come to find out, my room wasn't his first stop, he went downstairs, made himself a pot of coffee and breakfast and was sitting as his computer getting ready to do some work. My belly laugh continued on for another 10 minutes after that.
